title: A phase II, open-label, randomized, multi-center study comparing the efficacy and safety of Sacituzumab govitecan versus investigator's choice in patients with cancer of unknown primary (CUP) who are relapsed after or refractory to platinum-based chemotherapy (SACICUP)
official: A phase II, open-label, randomized, multi-center study comparing the efficacy and safety of Sacituzumab govitecan versus investigator's choice in patients with cancer of unknown primary (CUP) who are relapsed after or refractory to platinum-based chemotherapy (SACICUP)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate progression-free survival (PFS) of Sacituzumab govitecan versus investigator´s choice in participants with poor-prognosis CUP (non-specific subset) who are relapsed after or refractory to platinum-based first-line chemotherapy

interventions.name: Trodelvy 200 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Able to understand and give written informed consent
2. Disease relapse or progression after at least three cycles of a platinum-based standardchemotherapy not limited to those listed in Table 2. There is no upper limit of priortreatments received
3. At least 2 weeks beyond prior systemic anti-cancer treatment (chemotherapy,immunotherapy and/or targeted therapy) and recovered from all acute toxicities to Grade1 or less (except alopecia and peripheral neuropathy) at the time of study entry
4. Participants who have received major prior surgery and/or radiotherapy and/orstereotactic brain metastasis radiosurgery are eligible. In case of prior major surgerypatients must have recovered adequately from the toxicity and/or complications from theintervention prior to starting therapy. In case of radiotherapy and/or stereotactic brainmetastasis radiosurgery, (i) the measurable lesion(s) must not have been irradiated, (ii)radiotherapy has to be finished at least 14 days before inclusion into the study and patientmust have recovered to grade 1 or less from any toxicity
5. Recovery from active infections requiring intravenous antibiotics, with intravenousantibiotic therapy ceased for ≥ 7 days prior to planned start of therapy
6. Recovered from all toxicities to Grade 1 (NCI CTCAE version 6) or less by National CancerInstitute common terminology criteria for adverse events (NCI CTCAE) v6.0 at the time ofinclusion. Participants with toxicities attributed to prior anti-cancer therapy, which are notexpected to resolve and result in long lasting sequelae, such as alopecia, peripheralneuropathy and/or fatigue are permitted to enroll.
7. Adequate hematologic function, defined by the following laboratory results obtained within14 days prior to initiation of study treatment: -Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1,500/μl (without granulocyte colony-stimulatingfactor support within 2 weeks prior to the first study treatment) -Platelet count ≥ 100,000/μl (without transfusion within 2 weeks prior to the firststudy treatment) Hemoglobin ≥ 8.0 g/dl (Participants may be transfused or receive erythropoietic treatment to meet this criterion)
8. Adequate hepatic function, defined by the following laboratory results obtained within 14days prior to initiation of study treatment: -bilirubin ≤ 1.5 ULN (upper limit of normal) (in case of bilirubin > 1.5 ULN but ≤ 2.0ULN direct bilirubin ≤ 1.0 mg/dl required for inclusion) -aspartate aminotransferase [AST] and alanine aminotransferase [ALT] ≤ 2.5 x ULNor ≤ 5 x ULN if known liver metastases -serum albumin > 30g/l
9. Adequate renal function, defined by the following laboratory results obtained within 14days prior to initiation of study treatment: -creatinine ≤ 1.5 mg/dl or creatinine clearance ≥30 ml/min (according toCockroft-Gault), if creatinine is above 1.5 mg/dl
10. Male patients and female patients of childbearing potential who engage in heterosexualintercourse must agree to use protocol-specified method(s) of contraception
11. Willing and able to comply with the requirements and restrictions in this protocol
12. Age ≥ 18 years at time of signing Informed Consent Form
13. ECOG performance status of 0 – 2
14. Life expectancy ≥ 12 weeks
15. Histologically confirmed unfavourable CUP diagnosed according the criteria defined in the2023 ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for CUP 3. Acceptable disease histologiesinclude: -Adenocarcinoma of unknown primary site (ACUP -Poorly differentiated carcinoma of unknown primary site-Squamous cell carcinoma of unknown primary site (SCUP)
16. Availability of a routinely performed up-to date (max. 30 days old) CT or MRI scan ofthorax, abdomen and pelvis. CT or MRI imaging of the head and neck is only requiredwhen cerebral metastases are suspected clinically
17. At least one lesion that is measurable according to RECIST v1.1 (appendix 2) by CT/MRI -If a fresh biopsy is performed during Screening, the biopsy procedure must not affectmeasurability of disease -Tumor lesions situated in a previously irradiated area or in an area subjected to otherloco-regional therapy, are usually not considered measurable unless there has beendemonstrated progression in the lesion
18. Availability of test reports confirming local CUP diagnosis, or alternatively centralconfirmation of CUP diagnosis based on a submitted FFPE block or fresh biopsy sample
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants with any of the specific non-CUP neoplasms identified in the ESMO CUPguidelines 3
2. History of an active second malignancy other than CUP within 3 years prior to screening.As an exception, patients with malignancies with no evidence of active cancer for threeyears prior to enrollment, or patients with surgically or radiotherapeutically cured tumorswith low risk of recurrence (eg, nonmelanoma skin cancer, histologically confirmedcomplete excision of carcinoma in situ, localized prostate cancer, stage I uterine canceror similar) are allowed to enroll
3. Any other disease, psychiatric condition, metabolic dysfunction, physical examinationfinding, or clinical laboratory finding that contraindicates the use of an investigational drug,may affect the interpretation of the results, or may render the patient at high risk fromtreatment complications
4. Failure to recover (ie ≥ Grade 2 is considered not recovered) from AEs due to a previouslyadministered agent (patients with any grade neuropathy or alopecia are an exception tothis criterion and qualify for the study)
5. Positive serum pregnancy test or women who are breastfeeding
6. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to any component of the study treatment withSacituzumab govitecan, its metabolites or formulation
7. Previous treatment with topoisomerase 1 inhibitors
8. Use of other investigational drugs (drugs not marketed for any indication) within 28 daysor 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) of first dose of study drug. No participation in anotherclinical trial is allowed while patients are screened and treated in SACICUP.
9. Participants belonging to any of the following subsets of CUP with favorable prognoses: -Single metastatic deposit or oligometastatic disease amenable to local ablativetreatment (single-site or oligometastatic CUP) -Women with isolated axillary lymph node metastases (breast-like CUP) -Women with peritoneal carcinomatosis of a serous papillary adenocarcinoma (ovary-like CUP) -Squamous cell carcinoma involving non-supraclavicular cervical lymph nodes (headand neck-like CUP) -Men with blastic bone metastases and/or IHC or serum PSA expression (prostate-like CUP) -Adenocarcinoma with colorectal IHC (CK7-, CK20+, CDX2+) or molecular profile(colon-like CUP) -Carcinoma with renal cell histological and immunohistochemical profile (renal-likeCUP)
10. Disease manifestations amenable to resection and/or irradiation with curative intent duringthe course of the study
11. Known presence of brain or spinal cord metastasis, as determined by CT or magneticresonance imaging (MRI) evaluation during screening. As an exception, patients withbrain metastases are allowed to be included if all of the following five criteria are met: (i)the total number of brain metastases is 5 or less (ii)brain metastases were / are asymptomatic (iii)brain metastases have been completely surgically resected or completelytreated with stereotactic radiosurgery (iv)there was/is no indication for whole-brain irradiation (v)a brain MRI or high-resolution CT-scan at screening shows no evidence ofresidual disease
12. History or known presence of leptomeningeal disease
13. Known history of HIV-1 or 2 (or positive HIV-1/2 antibody if done at screening) withdetectable viral load or taking medications that may interfere with SN-38 metabolism
14. Active hepatitis B (HBV) or active hepatitis C (HCV) (each defined by detectable viral loadsof HBV DNA or HCV RNA, respectively)
15. Active chronic inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn´s disease) or GIperforation within 6 months of enrollment
16. Significant cardiovascular disease as defined as any of the following criteria: -myocardial infarction or unstable angina pectoris within 6 months of enrollment -history of serious ventricular arrythmia (ie, ventricular tachycardia or ventricularfibrillation), high-grade atrioventricular block, or other cardiac arrhythmias requiringantiarrhythmic medications (except for atrial fibrillation that is well controlled withantiarrhythmic medication); history of QT interval prolongation-NYHA class III or greater congestive heart failure or left ventricular ejection fractionof <40%
